questions.question: Daniel explained a king's dream about a great tree that was cut down. Who did the tree stand for?
While walking on his palace roof, what did King Nebuchadnezzar say about the city of Babylon?

answers.text: He built it all by his own power
It was all a gift from the Most High
It had grown too big for one king

questions.question: After King Nebuchadnezzar lived like a wild animal, what happened when he looked up to heaven?

answers.text: His sanity was restored to him
Daniel found him in the field

questions.question: At the end of his message, what did King Nebuchadnezzar say the King of heaven is able to do?

answers.text: Humble those who walk in pride
